h1.en: WHAT is Acceptance Testing: concrete pump S-tube valve
h1.zh: 什么是验收试验：S管阀：已公布的配件是密封套件

directAnswer.en: Acceptance testing is only the order of the sections. The cells under those headings stay the cells already printed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes the S-tube seal kit, not a separate S-tube valve-body size table. The published table prints Part type S-tube large-end and small-end seal kit; Large-end sizes listed φ210 / φ220 / φ250 (set; some six-piece); Small-end sizes listed φ80 / φ90 / φ100 / φ105; Unit Set. The valve-body outer diameter, a material grade and a service life are missing fields. Do not treat a seal-kit mark as the valve-body diameter.

heading.en: How Should Acceptance Testing be Done

body.en: Under the source heading “How Should Acceptance Testing be Done”, the wording that follows is the printed catalogue fragment. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Name the S-tube seal kit and one printed mark from that page, plus the quantity in sets. Leave the valve-body diameter and service life blank. No list price is printed. Image from the source page: https://www.nrmca.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/41pr.pdf
body.zh: 在来源标题“验收试验应当怎样做”下面，接着写的是已经印出的目录片段。请用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械。写明 S 管密封套件、该页一个已印标记，以及套数。阀体直径和寿命留空。没有印出标价。 图来自来源页：https://www.nrmca.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/41pr.pdf
